meta.scope: Source-audited planning atlas; no game or spine edits.
meta.artist_evidence: Descriptions and search URLs supplied by the user; not independently verified art history.
meta.placement_scope: Exact registry key in layers.interactables in current active-spine map_data.json files. No direct token does not exclude generated, nested, branch or dynamic placement.
meta.readiness_scope: Capability gates use the declared ladder, whose nodes currently have proposed status. They do not prove a finished tutorial, student competence or artifact runtime health.

matches.provided_operation: Bichos / O dentro é o fora. Hinged planes; topology becomes interaction.
matches.smallest_next_study: Use the hinge-and-return companion: compare retained and restored poses, then two corner paths to the same pose.

matches.provided_operation: folded / bent image surfaces; painting treated as deformable plane.

matches.provided_operation: ceramic fold; rigid material carrying the memory of bending.

matches.provided_operation: bent structure; curvature as construction rather than decoration.

matches.provided_operation: Torqued Ellipses; bending changes navigation, horizon and bodily orientation.
matches.smallest_next_study: Enlarge an authored bent surface and test the walking clearance around it.
matches.critical_remainder: Navigation requires a matching collider; steel weight is not supplied by a grey material.

matches.provided_operation: Soft Toilet and soft sculpture; hard object translated into limp body.
matches.smallest_next_study: Give a familiar rigid prop a matched deformable version under the same load.
matches.critical_remainder: The translation depends on recognising the original object as well as seeing softness.

matches.provided_operation: draped metallic skins; grid made soft by gravity.

matches.provided_operation: translucent fabric architecture; soft memory of rooms and thresholds.

matches.provided_operation: rubber / soft sculptural bodies; sluggish, synthetic tactility.

matches.critical_remainder: Material response should be felt, not inferred from a rubber shader.

matches.provided_operation: suspended and propped materials; provisional balance.

matches.provided_operation: serial domestic / industrial forms; grids become bodily and threatening.

matches.provided_operation: accumulation of ordinary units into emergent form.

matches.provided_operation: thread networks; drawing becomes navigable 3D entanglement.

matches.provided_operation: overloaded, provisional architectures of information and matter.
